text: This video was not edited. It was compiled. A Playwright script recorded it, a local A I voice narrated it, and every transition you are about to see came from a motion catalog.
This is Hyper Frames, by Hey Jen. An open source motion library for video: over a hundred and forty blocks, components, and shader transitions, all written in plain H T M L.
And this is argo. It drives your real product with Playwright, narrates with local text to speech, directs the camera, and exports a finished video. One command, end to end.
Together they are more than the sum. argo add installs film grain, a cinematic vignette, and branded end cards straight from the Hyper Frames catalog. Watch the grade land on this very footage.
Every scene boundary in this video was a Hyper Frames shader, rendered by argo's export pipeline. And this end card? A catalog block, pre rendered frame by frame. Demos as code. Motion as catalog.
